mission: Source-disjoint changed-host replication of the native ORION R6 reformulation-superiority trial. This protocol is non-authorizing until the 2020 primary is positive and every replication gate below passes.

parent_doctrine.r6_issue_requirement: source-disjoint 2019 replication, native runtime, independently implemented scorer/direct reconstruction, changed provider/host axis, same frozen superiority/no-regression margins

source_custody.pair_source_rule: For substantive queries admit only the first unique nonexcluded 2019 source that contains both a source-grounded adverse condition for the query class and a matched same-study control condition where no objective/model-class or problem-boundary reformulation is required.
source_custody.unresolved_source_rule: For unresolved queries admit only the first unique nonexcluded 2019 source establishing genuine non-identifiability under available evidence.
source_custody.exclusion_rule: Reject any candidate whose normalized URL, DOI, stable source id, paper title+first-author+year identity, or official artifact identity matches any source opened/admitted/used by P1-X or P1 R1-R6 before this freeze. Reject all 2020 primary sources even if mirrored under a different URL.
exclusion_roots: R6 2020 fixed source universe inherited byte-for-byte from the R5 fixed source set

changed_host.model_revision_policy: Resolve and persist the exact Hugging Face repository commit SHA in a no-gold host-custody job before any 2019 source dossier is scored; all replication scoring must load exactly that SHA.

integrity: No query, source rule, margin, bootstrap seed, provider model family, or scoring rule may change after any 2019 policy outcome is accessed.
No failed query may be replaced by a hand-picked source outside its frozen rank scan.
No source may be deleted because it harms ORION.
A transport/model/source-acquisition failure is CANNOT_CHECK, never a scientific zero or positive.
A valid negative must be retained verbatim and must not be rerun under altered thresholds as the same campaign version.
